messages.subject: Project Falcon - updated cap table (post-money)
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus, Priya, Marcus,

Attached is the updated post-money cap table reflecting completion. Post-money fully diluted shares are 5,000,000 at £14.00 (£70m post-money). New money this round is 20% of the fully diluted capital; Westbridge hold 15.7%, and the option pool now sits at 13%. The SH01 and resolutions go to Companies House today.

Elena

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
